name: Pepper
description: Pepper is a Bid Euchre variant from Iowa and Ohio. 24 cards (9-A), right/left bowers. Bid 1-5, little pepper (6), or big pepper (6, doubled stakes). 4p partnerships, 6 cards each.

overview.description: Pepper is a Bid Euchre variant from Iowa and Ohio. 24 cards (9-A), right/left bowers. Bid 1-5, little pepper (6), or big pepper (6, doubled stakes). 4p partnerships, 6 cards each.

history.origins: Pepper is a Bid Euchre variant played in Iowa and Ohio, USA. The name derives from Hasenpfeffer (German for peppered hare), a term that appears in card-game books for a related bidding game. It uses a 24-card pack with right and left bowers, and bids from one to five plus little pepper (six tricks) and big pepper (six tricks, doubled stakes). The game is a regional Midwestern variant widely described in trick-taking and Euchre literature.
timeline: Widely described in trick-taking and Euchre game literature.
history.evolution: Some play opponents penalised if they take no tricks; surrender option.

setup.deck: 24 cards. Rank: J (right), J (left), A, K, Q, 10, 9.
setup.dealing: 6 each, one at a time. Clockwise.

rules.objective: Bid number of tricks; make bid to score. Highest bidder names trump or no trump.
rules.gameplay: 1. Bidding: 1-5, little pepper (6), big pepper (6, double). 2. High bidder leads. 3. Follow suit. 4. Right bower = trump J; left = other J same colour. 5. 6 tricks. Some variants: opponents penalised for 0 tricks; surrender option.
keyRules: High bidder names trump or NT.

strategy.basic: Bid according to trump strength. Save bowers.
strategy.advanced: Partner inference. Big pepper when confident.

variations.name: Opponent Penalty
variations.description: Opponents penalised if they take 0 tricks; surrender option.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Opponent penalty and surrender are rule variants; overrides not yet mapped to engine constants.

scoring.description: Make bid = score. Fail = penalties. Big pepper doubles.

synthesis.shortDescription: Iowa Bid Euchre. 24 cards. Little/big pepper.
